messages:
claire (Finance): Heads-up: NimbusEdge disputed invoice INV-4399. They claim committed capacity offsets didn't apply to auto-scale overage lines for Feb. Can billing confirm?
omar-csm: Customer says committed pool should have covered the first 2,000 GPU-min per day; they were billed for overage. AE is on call.
zhen-billing: Pulling invoice lines and commitment mapping now. Give me a few.
dev-ops: FYI there was a config rename in the commitment service (field 'commit_scope' -> 'commit_scope_v2') during the Feb rollout. If invoice renderer queried the old field it may miss active commitments.
zhen-billing: Exported invoice lines: /secure/exports/INV-4399-lines.csv. I see committed lines present but overage lines show no applied offsets.
claire (Finance): Can you calculate the missed offset quantity and dollar amount? We need a proposed credit.
zhen-billing: Quick calc: missed committed offset = 1,760 GPU-min. Unit price billed for overage = $0.08/min -> overcharge = $140.80. Also recommend a $150 goodwill credit due to billing confusion and AE time.
omar-csm: Customer expects explanation and corrected invoice. Also they lost a late-payment discount because dunning triggered; can we reverse late fees? Late fees = $25.
claire (Finance): Revised proposed credit = $315.80 (round to $316). Approve manual credit? Need credit memo and journal.
billing-bot: Created ticket FIN-1172 (commitment-offset-miss).
zhen-billing: Creating credit memo CM-827 for $316. Journal JE-2026-05-INV4399 queued. Will attach CSV and include note referencing config rename MR-793.
dev-ops: Adding a migration check to ensure commitment aliasing remains backward compatible. Also scheduling a sweep for invoices generated 2026-02-10..2026-02-20.
omar-csm: I'll draft customer note: "We discovered a configuration rename that prevented committed offsets from applying on invoice INV-4399. We've issued a $316 credit and corrected the system. Sorry for the inconvenience."
claire (Finance): Approving. Please mark FIN-1172 resolved once credit posts and customer notified.
nbilling: (typo)
claire (Finance): small typo in thread but all set. Closing.
